'''2016 EGP Barry Alperstein LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Barry Alperstein]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)|Dagobah-L-angerfearaggression.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Alperstein LS 2016 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
